# components/context-menu

Import: `import { ContextMenu } from "@tundralibs/ui/context-menu"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/context-menu.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `ContextMenu`

```ts
ContextMenu(props: ContextMenuProps): Html
```

A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click (or a long press on
touch, Shift+F10 / the Menu key from the keyboard) on any element
carrying `data-context-menu="#<id>"` (context-menu.js). It is placed at
the pointer, flips to stay on screen, walks its items with the arrow
keys, and closes on a pick, Escape, an outside click, a scroll or a
resize — focus returns to the element it opened on. Rendered hidden;
without the script the browser's own context menu stays.

## Types

### `ContextMenuProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: triggers point at it with `data-context-menu="#<id>"`. |
| `content` | `Html` | yes | The items — a `Menu({ items })`, or any list of `.menu__link` links and buttons. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the menu. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Actions on a file card

Any element with `data-context-menu="#<id>"` opens the menu at the pointer (right-click, long press, Shift+F10). Give it `tabindex="0"` so the keyboard can reach it.

```ts
html`
  ${Card({
    title: "Quarterly report.pdf",
    body: html`<p>2.4 MB</p>`,
    attrs: { "data-context-menu": "#file-menu", tabindex: "0" },
  })}${ContextMenu({
    id: "file-menu",
    label: "File actions",
    content: Menu({
      items: [
        { label: "Open", href: "/files/42" },
        { label: "Rename", href: "/files/42/rename" },
        { label: "Move to trash", href: "/files/42/trash" },
      ],
    }),
  })}
`
```

```html
<div class="card" data-context-menu="#file-menu" tabindex="0">
  <div class="card__content">
    <div class="card__header">
      <div class="card__heading">
        <div class="card__title">Quarterly report.pdf</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card__body">
      <p>2.4 MB</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="context-menu" id="file-menu" aria-label="File actions" role="menu" data-context-menu-panel="" hidden="" tabindex="-1">
  <ul class="menu__list">
    <li>
      <a class="menu__link" href="/files/42">
        <span class="menu__link-label">Open</span>
      </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a class="menu__link" href="/files/42/rename">
        <span class="menu__link-label">Rename</span>
      </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a class="menu__link" href="/files/42/trash">
        <span class="menu__link-label">Move to trash</span>
      </a>
    </li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/context-menu/context-menu.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.context-menu`, `.menu__link`

## Behaviour

`components/context-menu/context-menu.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-context-menu`, `data-context-menu-panel`, `data-toggle`.
